m.d: A square (￭) is a form with 4 equal sides and 4 equal angles.
If you square a number, you multiply it by itself. It is represented in math as x² where x is the number being squared.
If something is square, it is shaped like a sqaure.
A squad is a group of people.
m.e: The England cricket squad won their last match.

m.d: When you squeeze something, you press it very tightly in your hand.
m.e: I squeezed orange juice from the orange with my bare hands!

m.d: A squirrel is a small animal that lives in trees and has a bushy tail. They are related to rats and often eat nuts.
m.e: A squirrel is on the roof of my home.

m.d: A squeal is a loud sound.
m.e: The brakes of my car squeal loudly. They are broken down and noisy

m.d: A squeal is the cry of a pig.
m.e: The pigs in my farm squeal continuously as they are hungry.

m.d: If you squeal, you scream with a very loud shocking noise.
m.e: My neighbor upstairs keep on producing lots of squeal noise. It's scary.

m.d: If you squeal, you give sensitive information about someone to others.
m.e: My colleague squeal on me, I hate him.

m.d: A squadron is a unit in an air force unit that is made up of at least two aircrafts.
Squash is a fast game played indoors with a small ball and a racquet.
m.e: He was a great squash player.

m.d: A squash is a type of plant that has edible fruits.
To squash is to press something into a smaller space, or to put weight onto it.
m.e: He sat on the balloon and squashed it.

m.d: A squid is a cephalopod (a type of sea creature) with a large head and ten legs.
m.e: The squid is not able to grow a leg after it is severed.

m.d: A squat is a position of a person when they bend at the knees while resting on their feet.
m.e: She sank into a squat, and hung her head.

m.d: If a person or animal squats, they bend deeply at the knees while resting on their feet.
m.e: She squatted down beside the dog to give it a snack.

m.d: Someone or something that is squat is short and thick in an unattractive way.
m.e: Every time I walk past, I think what a squat ugly building it is.

m.d: A squire is a shield-bearer or armor-bearer of a knight.
If you 'squire, you accompany or escort someone
A squeak is a high-pitched sound that objects produce, especially when rubbing together.
m.e: The squeak of this old door is so annoying!

m.d: If something squeaks it produces this kind of sound.
m.e: His wheelchair is always squeaking when it moves.

m.d: A squeaky sound is a sound that has a very high pitch.
m.e: When sped up, people speaking get a funny squeaky voice.

m.d: A squish is the sound of something moist being squeezed or crushed.
If you squish something, you squeeze or crush it.
A squeamish person is someone who is easily shocked or frightened.
